title: Sort by date option
body: It’s a good notes app honestly and I use it regularly but I really would like it to be sorted by date. And if it could also show the original date it was created and not just the edited date. It would be useful that I can remember the exact date I wrote it without having to sign online and hover over it - so for this reason only 3 stars. Please fix that. It’s been years, time for upgrades that are useful.
author: Chanz🍃
